{{Update |title1 = v1.48.0 |image1 = FireworkTechnicianThumbnail2.png |release_date = 8 January 2025 (v1.48.0) |minor_updates = v1.48.1 (8 January 2025)
v1.48.1a (8 January 2025) |feed_title = v1.48.0 |feed_color = Purple |previous_update = [[v1.47.0]] |next_update = [[v1.49.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.48.0''' is the one hundred and first update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 8th of January 2025. It brought in a few quality of life changes and multiple bugfixes. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.48.0 (released 8 January 2024) and two minor updates, the v1.48.1 (released 8 January 2024) and v1.48.1a (released 8 January 2024). ==Removals== *[[Cold Ambush]] *[[Tower Outskirts]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *'''Back From Infernal''' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] updated. **Second objective now requires [[Molten Warlord]] kills instead of [[Molten Boss]] kills. **Third objective now requires [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode triumphs instead of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode triumphs. *[[Logbooks]] are now guaranteed to drop after an enemy has been killed 20 times in matches, as long as it has not dropped from that enemy before. *[[Firework]] gamepass taken offsale. *Non-event towers are now unlocked for free in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode with the Admin Mode. *[[Field Medic]] no longer provides a shield to the [[Molten Monster]], but it still heals it. *[[Siege Engine]] now has a [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description. *Updated [[Deep Freeze]]'s animation. *Fixed [[Snowballer]] dealing damage to an enemy before the projectile hits it. *Fixed [[Pursuit]] not targeting [[Flying]] enemies properly. *Fixed [[Pyromancer]] and [[Cryomancer]] struggling to hit enemies when they have to look up or down to attack them. *Fixed unit splash damage not contributing to damage requirements. *Fixed [[Paintballer]] using the explosion visual effects instead of its own explosion effects. *Fixed explosion [[Damage Indicators]] being red for some towers. *Fixed [[Packed Ice]] creating [[Mystery]] death particles on death. :In '''v1.48.1''': *Attempted to properly apply the collision bugfixes, though none of them were actually applied. :In '''v1.48.1a''': *Fixed {{Color|OperationICE|Frost Legion}} [[Mercenary Base]] units having collisions. *Fixed {{Color|Mission|Cybernetic}} [[Crook Boss]] units having collisions. *Fixed {{Color|Deluxe|Liberator}} [[Riot Guard]] having collisions at Level 0. *Fixed {{Color|OperationICE|Dark Frost}} [[Minigun Sentry]] having collisions. *Fixed {{Color|OperationICE|Frost Legion}} [[Field Medic]] having its shields be green. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes|
